claims.claim: Interior extrema (strongest instant inside a window, via maximise_earliest)
claims.wording: implemented and unit-tested, not exercised by the measuring run (all_null policy)
claims.cause: The measuring run used result_policy all_null_candidate/1, whose branch leaves every score and peak empty and continues before the extremum search is reached. Windows in the golden carry only 5 fields (event_class, hi, lo, path_id, rule_version): 0 windows with a peak or score field, 0 with a peak instant. All 13258 window edges equal a member support edge, so 0 edges come from an extremum; extrema never move an edge, so that count cannot test them either. This is 0 by construction, not a finding of absence.

re_entry.required_measured_row: In the J-4d slice qualification and again in the J-4e readback: count of windows with peak fields set, and count of maximise_earliest edges. Both must be > 0 wherever the rules admit them; 0 is a defect, not a pass.
re_entry.caveat: Records whose factors are not constant stay NULL under the dynamic-objective switch (window_sweep.py:613), so the count applies to rules that admit a peak.
